_about: SEO Package 2 checkpoint. articles.<slug>.status is DONE (>= 1,600 words, verified batch) or REVIEW_REQUIRED (reason required); absent = PENDING. batches.notes: Group A, queue 2/10/17/88/91. Tay Ho, Long Bien, 50cc and Vision-vs-Janus passed independent verification (Vision first time, the others after one fix round); Old Quarter needed three rounds and its last fixes were applied from the third verifier's findings and checked by lint and QA (no fourth independent pass). Removed or reworded original passages: Old Quarter ranked order and the unsourced half-the-residents, lightest-steering, 15 km/h and peak-season availability claims; Long Bien invented deposit, after-hours-return and minutes-away claims; 50cc compulsory-insurance-carried-by-the-fleet sentence (conflicts with OWNER-FACTS) and the unsourced no-official-new-50s claim; Tay Ho common-delivery-destination sentence softened (owner to confirm); Vision-vs-Janus bullet that contradicted the engine section. No weekly, monthly, 50cc or E-Bike price added (docs/seo/price-reconciliation.md). Findings for the owner: do-electric-motorbikes-need-insurance-vietnam (Package 2 queue 387) and do-you-need-insurance-for-50cc-vietnam (out of scope, unchanged) state fleet insurance cover, which conflicts with OWNER-FACTS; hoan-kiem-walking-street-motorbike-visitors does not mention the 1 July 2026 Zone 1 evening restriction.

batches.notes: Group A, queue order of the second batch. Every article passed an independent verifier; pickup-or-delivery, Noi Bai arrival, first-time renting, best scooters and can-foreigners needed a fix round and passed a delta verification; automatic-vs-manual (one MAJOR, replaced with the verifier's wording) and the MINOR findings elsewhere were applied by the lead and checked by lint and QA. Recorded front matter changes: how-to-book title now carries its primary keyword ("Motorbike rental app Hanoi") and says there is no app; pickup-or-delivery description drops "and test-ride" (no test-ride policy in OWNER-FACTS); best-scooters description named three models, claimed what foreigners actually rent and lacked "Hanoi scooter rental"; can-foreigners description says deposit instead of cash deposit. Delivery-old-quarter title deliberately unchanged: a title with motorbike rental plus Hanoi Old Quarter would compete with the ranking /articles/renting-motorbike-old-quarter/. Removed or reworded original passages: how-to-book "both work for foreign numbers", "in Vietnamese or simple English" and three implied shop policies (photos on the spot, test ride and swap, booking secures the bike); how-to-rent "Shops will hand you a bike without asking" and the deposit-comes-back sentence; pickup-or-delivery test-riding lead clause, test-ride/swap, first ten minutes, deliverer present, deposit and contract travel, quickest deposit settlement, inside a few kilometres; Hoan Kiem one-way loop, actively enforced, roughly fifteen minutes and case-by-case delivery; Noi Bai 25-30 km (now 27 km from the Vietnam Airlines guide), the shop-cannot-hand-you-a-bike-at-the-terminal sentence and two unsourced airport-road claims; automatic-vs-manual The Vietnamese default, Learning time: minutes, less ground clearance, narrower/lighter/every roadside shop, cheapest and simplest (the day rates are equal); best-scooters three models dominate, most popular scooter in Vietnam, the unverified Click bodywork/running-gear sentence, suits most riders, the regular-unleaded/serviced-by-the-shop bullet; first-time automatics creep from idle (a centrifugal clutch is disengaged at idle), most visitors use, nerves wear off within a day; delivery-old-quarter ten minutes, about fifteen minutes' ride, identical to the shop version; can-foreigners the lead claim that foreigners rent every day with no residence status or bank account needed, stock changes week to week, return deposits, process takes minutes, foreigners rent here every day, the phone-number and residence-card lines, old A1 up to 175 cc, Under 50 cc, every fine amount (Decree 238/2026/ND-CP amends Decree 168/2024 from 15 August 2026 and its amended Article 18 could not be read). No weekly, monthly, 50cc or E-Bike price added (docs/seo/price-reconciliation.md). Legal correction outside the batch: motorbike-passenger-rules-vietnam and child-passengers-motorbike-vietnam said a child under 14 with an adult may be a second passenger; Law 36/2024/QH15 Article 33(1)(c), as quoted by the Government page both articles cite, says a child under 12 with no adult condition (re-read 2026-10-25). Findings for the owner: exploring-hoan-kiem-by-motorbike and hoan-kiem-walking-street-motorbike-visitors describe one continuous Friday-to-Sunday closure (the 2026 reports give 19:00-24:00 on each day) and omit Zone 1; renting-motorbike-old-quarter omits the Zone 1 evening restriction and keeps an unsourced fifteen-minute ride; do-hanoi-rentals-include-helmets, helmet-law-vietnam and renting-motorbike-hanoi-one-day state helmet policies not in OWNER-FACTS; motorbike-rental-requirements-hanoi and compulsory-motorbike-insurance-vietnam state insurance carried by the shop, against OWNER-FACTS; motorbike-rental-deposit-hanoi and returning-a-rental-motorbike-hanoi promise deposit return on the spot in cash; which-countries-idp-valid-vietnam and idp-validity-period-vietnam call an IDP without the national licence a document-carriage fine; the Decree 238/2026 amendment may affect fine amounts quoted across the legal guides; docs/MODEL-DATABASE.md gives the Vision as 110 cc where Honda publishes 109.5 cc and its Yamaha Sirius RC URL now returns 404.
